diseases.description: Inflammatory skin reaction caused by direct contact with allergens like nickel, poison ivy, or certain chemicals in cosmetics or jewelry.
diseases.primary_treatment: Topical corticosteroids, antihistamines, and allergen avoidance
prevention_tips: Wear protective gloves when handling chemicals
when_to_consult: No improvement after 2-3 weeks of self-care

diet: Avoid processed foods and excessive sugar
lifestyle: Keep skin well-moisturized with natural oils
Shower immediately after potential allergen exposure
ayurvedic_prevention_remedies.disclaimer: Ayurvedic remedies may support wellness but are not a substitute for medical treatment.

diseases.description: Allergic inflammation of the nasal airways occurring when allergens like pollen, dust mites, or animal dander are inhaled.
diseases.primary_treatment: Intranasal corticosteroids, oral/nasal antihistamines, leukotriene receptor antagonists, and allergen immunotherapy
prevention_tips: Use HEPA air filters at home
Wash bedding weekly in hot water
Check pollen forecasts and limit outdoor activity during high counts
Use mite-proof covers on pillows and mattresses
when_to_consult: Symptoms persist >2 weeks despite OTC treatment
Severe nasal congestion causing difficulty breathing
Symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities

diet: Avoid cold, heavy, and dairy products during allergy season
Include ginger and tulsi in daily diet
lifestyle: Nasya therapy (nasal administration of medicated oils)
ayurvedic_prevention_remedies.disclaimer: Ayurvedic remedies may support wellness but are not a substitute for medical treatment.
